rollups.text: Film festivals and events: Tech Expo in New York City (September 2022), including an AI-in-healthcare panel; Sundance and Rotterdam film festivals (attended before October 25, 2022; exact dates unspecified); planned Tribeca Film Festival in New York City as a press delegate (planned for April 2023, arriving April 15); considered a large e-commerce industry expo in Los Angeles (November 2022, attendance depended on manager approval; event unidentified).

rollups.text: Reading interests and books: the user enjoyed historical fiction including The Nightingale by Kristin Hannah and was reading The Hating Game (2022-11-18); set a goal of at least two books per month for the rest of 2022 (2022-11-18); expressed interest in The Alice Network by Kate Quinn and Eleanor Oliphant Is Completely Fine by Gail Honeyman (2022-11-18). Recommendations were suggestions, not confirmed reads.

Podcasts the user listens to: The Mindful Kind, The Daily Boost, and The History Chicks (reported 2022-11-18). The user listens during a daily commute and spends about 10–12 hours per week listening; they particularly like self-improvement and motivation shows similar to The Daily Boost. The user considered using Trello to manage podcasts and an episode queue (2022-11-18).

Crafts and creative activities: the user enjoys painting, knitting, and sewing and can spend a few hours weekly on crafts (reported 2022-11-18); planned a knitted scarf as a birthday gift for the user's sister and a quilt for the user's niece (reported 2022-11-18); wanted to keep painting at least 30 minutes per week and planned to try palette-knife acrylic painting and salt texture (2022-11-18).

Thesis timeline: submitted thesis proposal on February 15 (year unspecified); by 2022-11-18 planned to use Mendeley for sources and Evernote for notes; chose a literature-review subfolder within the existing research folder; said the literature-review organization system was set up and sought guidance on research methodology. Conducted a pilot study March 10–17 (year unspecified), which helped refine survey questions and identify study-design issues; planned to use participant feedback in the main study. Study topic and year of proposal and pilot were not established.

Tribeca Film Festival trip: on 2022-10-25, the user expressed enthusiasm for Tribeca after recently attending Sundance and Rotterdam; planned to attend the festival in New York City as a press delegate, arriving 2023-04-15, and sought a hotel near Lower Manhattan venues. The user booked Carmel Car and Limousine Service for the April 15 arrival. No record confirms that the trip or festival attendance ultimately occurred.

Salsa development and performance: completed a beginner salsa course at DanceFever from mid-February to late March 2022 and became enthusiastic about salsa; experienced Afro-Cuban rhythms at a Latin dance festival on 2022-03-04; performed with Alex at a DanceFever social night on 2022-03-17. Later reported attending social nights every other Friday, practicing at home, and wanting to improve footwork and timing. By 2022-10-30 was considering another performance, a salsa routine to “Guantanamera” by Celia Cruz, and seeking salsa shoes. No later performance is confirmed.

Lenovo Yoga 730 stylus issue: by 2022-11-14 the touchscreen sometimes failed to respond to the stylus, with no identified pattern or error message. The user had restarted the laptop and cleaned the stylus tip without resolving the issue; they planned to try further troubleshooting, including calibration. The user had received the stylus about two weeks earlier, had no second stylus to test, and had been pleased with it for notes and document annotation. Resolution is not recorded.

Sleep and mental-health support: on 2022-11-18 the user reported recent trouble falling asleep, a busy mind at bedtime, and partial benefit from adjusting their sleep schedule and journaling before bed on their therapist's suggestion. The user had experienced anxiety and depression symptoms for about six months and had been seeing Dr. Smith for about three months after a breakdown. They reported practicing realistic or positive reframing, focusing on what they could control, yoga, meditation, and setting boundaries; these practices helped them feel more grounded, assertive, and confident. The user said a difficult conversation with their partner led to greater understanding and mutual support. Sleep difficulty was still sometimes present in the latest report.

Fitness and activity: by 2022-11-18 the user had been going to the gym consistently for three months and reported more energy and improved fitness, using a fitness app to track calories and workouts. Between 2022-10-18 and 2022-11-18 the user reported losing about five pounds, considered gradual progress acceptable, prioritized muscle building, and felt clothes fit better. The user took 30-minute lunch walks and completed a challenging but fun 5K hike with friends around 2022-11-12 or 2022-11-13. The user was working on core strength and flexibility and aimed to achieve a full split by the end of 2022; achievement is unconfirmed.

Google Calendar transition: on 2022-11-18 the user was considering replacing a physical planner with a digital calendar for better organization and accessibility, leaning toward Google Calendar because they already used Gmail and Google Drive. The user asked for setup instructions for a recurring Tuesday and Thursday 2:00 PM online-meeting event. Whether the user completed setup is unknown.

Living-room television setup: on 2022-11-18 the user had recently bought a 4K TV for living-room gaming, movies, and casual viewing, including family gatherings. They thought a full-motion mount would be ideal and asked about the Sanus VMF408. They were also considering a soundbar, comparing the Sonos Beam with the more budget-friendly Yamaha YAS-209, and planned further research. No mount or soundbar purchase is recorded.

Podcast listening: the user reported listening during a daily commute for approximately 10–12 hours per week, and named three favorite podcasts: The Mindful Kind, The Daily Boost, and The History Chicks (2022-11-18).

Gym progress: by 2022-11-18 the user reported three months of consistent gym attendance and about five pounds of weight loss over the preceding month (2022-10-18 to 2022-11-18). The user valued muscle building over weight loss and considered the gradual pace acceptable.

Calendar preference changed from using a physical planner to considering a digital calendar for improved organization and accessibility; by 2022-11-18 the user leaned toward Google Calendar because they already used Gmail and Google Drive. Completion of the switch is not confirmed.
